lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Citizens of the Ark, it's been a while.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: A few months have passed since our project was announced.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm sure you've all heard a fair amount of news about Project Matis during that time.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: While it is regrettable that not all of it has been positive,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: the attention it's received shows just how important the project is.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Now, with such a popular project underway,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: what could have possibly caused me to address you here today?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It must mean we've got some results to share with you, right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: There are some out there who already know,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: but allow me to introduce her to everyone else.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Behold, Missilis Industry's very first Hero Nikke!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Laplace!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Your hero is here!
Laplace lands on the stage heroically to cheers from the crowd.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Citizens of the Ark, it's good to meet you! My name's Laplace!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I hope for the day when everyone will once again regard Nikkes as heroes!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: To that end and from this day forward, Matis will be protecting the Ark! I will be protecting the Ark, as the strongest hero there is!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hear that? She has a great voice, huh?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I am here today to announce that Missilis Industry,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: with me, Syuen, at its helm,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: will continue to produce Nikkes of a brand-new caliber!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll devote everything I have to making new heroes to save the Ark.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Anyone who wishes to join Matis can apply at any time.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Project Matis is always waiting for new heroes!
Applause fills the conference hall,
as Syuen and Laplace shine brilliantly beneath the stage lights.
Completely gone is any trace of the child who once hid weeping in a secluded break room.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... She's really all grown up now.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Great job, pipsqueak.
Maxwell smiles as she watches.

lines.speaker: maleexecutive
lines.text: Maxwell!
Maxwell turns around.

lines.speaker: maleexecutive
lines.text: Save me...!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What's going...

lines.speaker: maleexecutive
lines.text: Syuen...!

lines.speaker: maleexecutive
lines.text: Syuen is trying to kill us all...!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Haha! Did you see that, Maxwell?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Everyone's beyond thrilled about Laplace!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The project's a resounding success.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Once I gather two more and form a squad, no one will ever be able to cross me again!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What? Why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... I want you to be honest with me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What did you do with the pills?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What... pills?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The ones that caused the second round of bodies to fail. The ones I brought to you.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What did you do with them?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I already told you. I used them to threaten those fools on the...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Did you feed them the pills as part of your threat?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The board executives.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Wh-what are you even talking about...? How would I even do that...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Did you or didn't you?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That executive on the news who died with full-body burns...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Are you telling me you had nothing whatsoever to do with that?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Of course I... didn't...
*Beep*
The sound of someone's voice comes out from the pen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: "You're the ones who showed me how to do it,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: "how to melt a person without leaving a shred of evidence."

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: "I'm literally just giving you a taste of your own medicine."

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Are you still going to deny it?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: M-Maxwell...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Why'd you do it...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Why would you do something like this?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: How could you give those pills to someone...?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You knew full well what it would do to them! How could you do something so cruel?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: They're the ones who started with the cruelty!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What else was I supposed to do?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If I didn't crush them, they'd just keep setting fire to what's mine.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: They tried to ruin my project. They even torched the lab and nearly got you killed...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If it weren't for Laplace, you'd be dead!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Was I supposed to sit there and do nothing?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I...! I didn't want anything taken away from me!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I didn't want to lose everything important to me and just be left there to cry about it again!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That doesn't excuse murder!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Just because something was taken from you, or something precious to you was threatened, it doesn't justify you killing someone.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Plenty of people have had miserable lives and still don't make that choice.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: They find another way. They make a different choice!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You really think it's that easy?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You know exactly what these people are like! They'll do anything to take me down!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If I don't hit back at them with the same force, or even more,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: they would've come after us! Me, you, Laplace... all of us! They would've tried to kill us!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I had to keep them in fear like my father did, or else they'd just keep looking down on me and try to ruin everything.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I had no choice...!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Did you even try anything else?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: All I'm hearing from you is conjecture.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You just assumed nothing else would work, right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Okay, then what else could I have possibly done?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're no longer that powerless little girl crying in the break room!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're the CEO of Missilis!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: With the same power that let you swap out someone's medicine,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: you could have just as easily forced them to face the law.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It would've taken a lot more time and effort, but I'm sure you could've done it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Did you ever once think to try something like that?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If not, you didn't really do this because you had no choice.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You did it because you decided it was the easiest and most efficient method.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Tell me I'm wrong.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen, do you know who kills people because it's efficient?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: A monster.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're doing the same thing that those monsters you were so afraid of do!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: A monster...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Did you just call me a monster?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How could you say that to me? You, of all people...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How could you call me a monster?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You said it yourself! That it was good I'd learned how to be tough on the board! You loved it!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Now suddenly I'm a monster?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I did all of it for you... I never wanted to see you get hurt again!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen... You...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Why do you make it sound like it's all my fault? You've seen everything that's happened to me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You know how miserable my life has been!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How can you condemn me?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How can you say it's all my fault?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: As soon as you kill someone, you lose the ability to debate who's at fault.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Why can you not understand that?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What, so you wanted me get everything taken away, to lose everything?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You wanted me to stay some useless idiot who can't do anything?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I never said that...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Then what? What do you want me to do?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Do you really not feel a single shred of remorse?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You murdered someone, Syuen. You took their life!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Choose your words more carefully. It's not like I did it myself.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Ordering a killing is still murder!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No! I never ordered anyone killed. I only had someone administer the drug.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How does that make it murder?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... What?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I gave them a warning. I told them to be careful of being anywhere too hot.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She didn't listen to me. She pulled the trigger herself!
Just then, a moment from the past resurfaces in Maxwell's mind.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Everyone born into Missilis is the same:

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: they're either a monster, or they fall short of becoming one.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: You think the small one is any different?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Is that so? I wonder if you'll still be able to say that once time has passed.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: If you can't bring yourself to leave the small one's side,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: the day will come when you'll realize the truth in my words.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: He was right all along...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're just... another monster from Missilis.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: When all's said and done...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Maxwell?
Maxwell walks over to Syuen's desk...
*Bam!*
... and slams down her letter of resignation.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What's... this?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Your resignation...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're... leaving me?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If you'd shown a shred of remorse, or even a little fear, I was just going to take the letter back home with me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But no.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You don't see anything wrong with what you did. Nothing.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I can't do it... I don't want to watch you fall apart any further.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You said it yourself.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I know all about your life.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're right. I was always there with you.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Partly because I felt bad for you, but mostly because I found you admirable, really remarkable.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Do you know why? Because you fought to live as a human inside this monstrous place.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I wanted to help you in any way I could,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: so I staked my entire life on you.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But... that's not the case anymore. You're no longer trying to live as a human.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Seeing the girl I staked my life on slowly turn into a monster...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That's not something I want to watch.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's not something I could ever watch.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm not going to report you.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm sure you could ensure it gets buried even if I did, with all the power you have now.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But, Syuen...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: When you do something wrong, there's always a price to pay.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It might not be immediate, but it will definitely come.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So just... stop now, while you still can. Don't let yourself become any more of a monster.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: M-Maxwell...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Take care, Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell!
Maxwell walks out.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ngh... nnngh...!
*Crash!*

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Aaaaagh!
The next day...

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What's wrong? You should be celebrating right now, but you look terrible.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Everything you wanted came true.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: The project is a success, you've got the entire board under your thumb,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: applicants for Matis have doubled,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: and I hear the second candidate for Matis has already been locked in.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I can't remember her name, but apparently she's quite eccentric.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They say she's unusually compatible with electrical energy and has a natural talent for detection.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: The sensors you couldn't fit Laplace with would go great on her.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Pair the two of them up and they'd have good synergy as a squad.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Get out.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm not in the mood to talk to you right now.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Did you get into a fight with someone?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I told you, just get out.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: For you to be so mopey at a time like this, it could only be one of two people.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Somehow I doubt you'd have anything to fight about with Laplace the hero.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: That leaves Maxwell.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Didn't you hear me the first two times? Get out.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: She found out, didn't she?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: She found out what we did with that drug, didn't she?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: That's why she's leaving. Right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How do you...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Did you tell her?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Of course not.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Why would I tell her? I'm involved in it too, remember.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I just guessed.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: She watched over you with so much care that anyone would've thought she was your mother.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: For someone like that to turn her back and walk out on you, it could only really be one thing.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: It means you crossed a line that she could never accept as a person.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: She's always been so human, to the point where it's hard to believe she's our chief engineer.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: You don't want to let her go, do you?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: You may be bitter and hurt that she won't understand how you feel,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: but then when you think of having to live without her, you don't know what to do.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Just like with Lala.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Stop acting like you know what you're talking about!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You have no idea! You know nothing!

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: We both know that's not true.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: No one in this world knows you better than I do.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: As a special gift for how nicely this has all wrapped up,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I've already arranged everything for you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: There's no need to get angry. All you need to do is choose.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Either keep her by your side forever,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: or let her go.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Phew! That should be everything...
Maxwell looks at the boxes piled in the middle of her lab.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Ugh, that's a lot of stuff.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I guess it makes sense... I did work here for a long time.
Maxwell sits down on the couch in the corner of the room.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Got plenty of use out of this couch, too.
Maxwell lifts her head and looks at the TV across from her.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen used to sit here and watch those superhero movies...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Time really does fly.
Leaning back into the couch, Maxwell gazes up at the ceiling.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Is walking away like this really the right thing to do?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Maybe I should've stayed and tried to change her somehow.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: No, this is right.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I've told her she's wrong and I'm stepping out of the picture.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Maybe that will be enough to help her understand what she did was wrong, at least a little.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's something I have to do, before she turns into any more of a monster.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: She's got Laplace beside her now, too, so... she'll be all right.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: All I can do now is... help her out if she ever gets backed into a corner someday.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Yeah. This is the right call.
*Knock, knock*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Who could that be...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm not expecting anyone.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Does the Matis lab need something else from me before I leave?
*Knock, knock, knock*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm coming, I'm coming. Just hold on a sec.
*Whirr*
Maxwell opens the door.
A letter lies out in the hallway.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What's a letter doing out here...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Is it from Syuen?
Maxwell takes a step out into the hallway.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Huh?
*Boom!*
